coordinates.donorReadmeNote: - The current Ganymede release uses true `2K` and `4K` derivatives from the checked-in USGS/NASA simple-cylindrical mosaic. Source feature coordinates in the USGS Gazetteer use Ganymede's IAU planetographic, positive-west, 0-360 system. Numeric marker longitudes in `data/ganymede-features.json` use the app's east-positive convention: `markerLongitude = -westLongitude`, normalized to `[-180, 180]`. Visual control checks: Tros is about `11 N, 27 W`; Osiris is about `38 S, 166.5 W`. Polar-cap entries are representative educational anchors rather than IAU feature centers.
